caption: The drawing depicts a two-seater sofa with a high backrest and curved armrests. The sofa is upholstered in brown material, with the upholstery delineated by a row of brass or gold-colored decorative tacks along the lower edge of the seat. The backrest is outlined in a smooth wave pattern with two prominent rounded peaks and a dip in the center. Both armrests are rolled outward at the ends. The sofa is supported by four wooden cabriole legs, each featuring carved details at the knee and terminating in ball-and-claw feet. The entire sofa is centered against a plain, off-white or beige background with no additional objects, textures, or patterns in the composition.
title: Settee
